<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/guide.ts -->
<!--
  A long read: sections with headings, text and an optional pull quote, in one reading column or beside a table
  of contents that links to each section. Axes: layout (column, toc), quotes (show, hide), tone. Highlighting
  the section being read is a port contract.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Section } from "./article-body.types";

export type ArticleBodyProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  sections: Section[];
  tocTitle: string;
  layout?: "column" | "toc";
  quotes?: "show" | "hide";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  sections,
  tocTitle,
  layout = "column",
  quotes = "show",
  tone = "default",
} = defineProps<ArticleBodyProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" density="default">
    <Grid
      cols="1"
      :class="cn(
        'items-start gap-8',
        (((layout as string) === 'toc') ? 'md:grid-cols-[14rem_minmax(0,1fr)]' : '')
      )"
    >
      <Block
        v-if="((layout as string) === 'toc')"
        tag="nav"
        class="md:sticky md:top-4"
        :aria-label="tocTitle"
        data-testid="toc"
      >
        <Stack gap="2">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ tocTitle }}
          </Text>
          <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
            <ListItem v-for="s in sections" :key="s.id">
              <Link
                :href="tpl('#{0}-{1}', id, s.id)"
                variant="default"
                class="text-sm text-muted-foreground"
                data-testid="toc-link"
              >
                {{ s.title }}
              </Link>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
        </Stack>
      </Block>
      <Stack gap="8" align="stretch" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-2xl min-w-0" data-testid="article">
        <Block
          v-for="s in sections"
          :key="s.id"
          tag="div"
          class="flex flex-col gap-4"
          :id="tpl('{0}-{1}', id, s.id)"
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <Title :as="3" size="2xl" weight="bold">
            {{ s.title }}
          </Title>
          <Text size="base">
            {{ s.text }}
          </Text>
          <template v-if="((quotes as string) === 'show')">
            <Block v-if="s.quote" tag="blockquote" class="m-0 border-l border-border pl-4 text-lg" data-testid="quote">
              {{ s.quote }}
            </Block>
          </template>
        </Block>
      </Stack>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
